statement: Clinic staff need double-booking prevented across their calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Staff confirm no double bookings in pilot

statement: The booking service shall reject a booking that overlaps an existing booking for the same tenant and resource.
acceptance_criteria: Overlapping booking request returns HTTP 409 in 100% of test cases

statement: The booking service shall return only bookings whose tenant_id equals the caller's tenant_id.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-tenant query returns 0 rows in 100% of test cases

statement: The reminder service shall send an appointment reminder between 23 and 25 hours before the appointment start.
acceptance_criteria: Reminder timestamp within 23-25 h window for 100% of test cases

statement: The booking service shall suggest the next free slot when a requested slot is taken.
acceptance_criteria: Suggested slot is free in 100% of test cases

statement: The booking service shall email the clinic manager on every booking.
